entries.finding: Appointment, invitation, office-holder self-reference, and biography are correctly distinguished while preserving the institutional title sense.
Question, verse, hall address, and signed preface voices are restored to their actual owners; the prior full-read sense judgment remains valid.
Questions and evening address are now separate utterances, with the Buddha retained as the invoked figure rather than a speaker.
First-person declarations and direct addresses now name their real speakers rather than a generic compiler; the bounded 'one phrase' sense still holds.
Changed listeners and triggering speakers are restored across all narrated awakening reports while MasterName remains null for narrator-owned clauses.
